description: This file defines the ContactsService class which implements the ContactsServicing protocol. It provides asynchronous methods to search, add, and manage contacts using the Contacts framework, with internal helper methods for authorization, normalization, and matching contacts.

classes.name: ContactsService
classes.description: A final class implementing contact searching and adding functionalities, handling permissions, contact creation, and matching logic.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Asynchronously searches contacts matching the query parameters and returns a payload with the contacts.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a new contact based on provided parameters, with checks for existing contacts.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Ensures the app has authorization to access contacts, potentially allowing limited access.

methods.name: authorizedStore
methods.description: Creates and returns an authorized CNContactStore instance, or throws an error if permission is not granted.

methods.name: normalizeStrings
methods.description: Normalizes array of strings by trimming, filtering empty strings, and optionally converting to lowercase.

methods.name: findExistingContact
methods.description: Finds an existing contact matching provided phone numbers or emails.

methods.name: matchContacts
methods.description: Matches contacts against provided phone numbers and emails with normalization.

methods.name: normalizePhone
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes digits from a phone number string.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Creates a payload object from a CNContact, including formatted display name and contact details.
